preconditions: Communications Server support is present. Generic deregistration also needs existing membership; explicitly end owned affinities using separate PERFORM ENDAFFINITY.
mutations: CLOSED drains current SNA LU/session tasks and rejects new tasks before ACB close. FORCECLOSE immediately abends tasks and sessions. IMMCLOSE immediately abends tasks, then shuts sessions orderly before close. OPEN opens closed ACB.
MNPS after Communications Server restart restores retained persistent sessions, but APPC synclevel2 sessions are unbound rather than restored.

Interval0..23:59:59 uses packed4-byte PSDINTERVAL or fullword components. Hours plus other components restrict minutes/seconds to59; a lone minutes/seconds component may exceed59. PSTYPE=NOPS requires zero; SNPS/MNPS require nonzero to exploit retention.

PSDINT is not stored in global catalog. Pass interval on ACB open; pass immediately if OPEN requested or ACB already open and not closed, otherwise on next successful open. Unsupported persistent sessions resets PSDINT to zero and returns INVREQ when passed, potentially on a later command, while continuing other requested processing.
Concurrent close may interrupt OPEN; recovery error may leave ACB open with failed session or close it. Predatory-XRF cleanup rejects OPEN without calling Communications Server until cleanup ends.
